_what: The product settings file start-a-place writes on a computer (do-work/start-a-place.mjs `productSettings`) and names in the place service's PRODUCT_SETTINGS (trillion-rust src/account_files/identity.json `launch_setting`, since trillion-rust 3b2a4d10; shape tests/fixtures/product-settings.json). Every value is the one the engines on the computers compiled in before that commit, copied from trillion-rust 3b2a4d10^: `word`, the hosts, `brand_mark_path` and `restore_placeholder_owner` from src/account_files/identity.json; `secret_home` from src/secrets/credential-home.json `app_secrets` (`home` and `items`); `root_credentials_folder` and `carried_from` from that same file; `tools_source` from src/runtime/workshop/tool-runs.json `workshop.source` (`repository`, `branch`, `first_start_commit`, `resolve`, `resolve_accept`, `archive`, and as `source_hosts` the hosts its resolve and archive addresses reach). `word` never changes for a product that has data: it is the vault's key context. No `hosting_app_report` (a place is not the hosting app: its report is its place config's `report`) and no `host_event_kinds` (a Linux place has no Mac shell sending events, and trillion-rust bac30d37, the feed's newest release, does not declare that section and would refuse the file).
